findings.observation: A terminal receipt reread exception left timing_reanalysis_candidate true even after evidence_status became READ_OR_FORMAT_ERROR.
findings.fix: Every caught read/format exception clears timing candidacy; final reread repeats root-boundary check.

findings.observation: Task index identity fields could be null; matching hash without matching task ID could link another task.
findings.fix: Validate nonempty task ID and lowercase SHA256; match (task ID,receipt hash), distinguish receipt-task conflict.

findings.observation: A JSON integer 10**400 in elapsed_seconds caused uncaught OverflowError.
findings.fix: finite_number rejects overflowing numeric conversion and row-level handler preserves malformed evidence.

usage_contract: Export is a per-file snapshot, not an atomic snapshot of the whole running directory. Terminal files created after path enumeration appear in a later export.
A complete export has parseable EXPORT_SUMMARY.json and a matching measurements_sha256. Partial directories from interrupted exports must not be consumed or reused.
Rows for wrapper and underlying receipt share raw_evidence_key and are not independent repetitions.
Timing candidacy requires later source/host/model/output-scope matching and does not create a new scientific pass.
Result vectors are intentionally omitted; independent-reference reassessment requires original local vectors.

initial_failure_observation.preservation: observed in tool response; before-change source hash was not captured because author corrected concurrently. The saved green log is labelled after correction.
